description: Roll up per-scenario cartographer findings into a maturity level (Opaque → Documented → Capability map → Domain-owned → Boundary+seams → Programmatic drift checks) per the screaming-architecture audit doctrine.

requirements.description: Cartographer must roll up per-scenario findings into a maturity level score following the screaming-architecture audit doctrine progression: Opaque → Documented → Capability map → Domain-owned → Boundary+seams → Programmatic drift checks. The score must be derivable from cartographer findings and manifest completeness metrics. The score must be surfaced via arch-cart maturity and in the UI, with a breakdown of which criteria are met and which are not.
requirements.title: Architecture Maturity Scoring per Scenario

validation.notes: Maturity scoring function maps conflict counts, manifest completeness, and domain coverage to the correct maturity level
A scenario with no manifest scores Opaque regardless of graph quality
A scenario with a complete manifest, zero drift conflicts, and active drift checks scores Programmatic drift checks
arch-cart maturity against bas/fixtures/medium-realistic/ returns a maturity level with a per-criterion breakdown
Maturity score decreases when a new cross-domain cycle is introduced into the fixture scenario
Maturity score is included in the UI scenario overview alongside conflict counts
An engineering leader can compare maturity scores across scenarios to prioritize architectural investment
Maturity score criteria are documented so teams can self-assess without running cartographer

title: Architecture Maturity Scoring
